players.product: data-center air-cooled & water-cooled chillers, CDUs (1.3 MW / 2.5 MW / 5 MW) and Nlyte DCIM

quarterly_data.signal: Carrier's second-quarter 2026 earnings release shows Climate Solutions Americas (CSA) segment net sales of $3,372 million versus $3,252 million a year earlier (+4%), with organic sales up 4% driven by Residential and Light Commercial (up 9% and 10%), partially offset by Commercial (excluding NORESCO) down 8% due to the timing of customer deliveries; segment operating margin was 24.4% versus 27.0%. Scope: CSA is Carrier's Americas segment combining Residential, Light Commercial and Commercial HVAC, so the segment total is not a data-center-only figure; the release does not break out data-center sales within it.
quarterly_data.figure: CSA net sales $3,372 million vs $3,252 million (+4%), three months ended June 30, 2026; CSA Commercial down 8%; segment operating margin 24.4% vs 27.0%
